title: Scalar restriction comparison of coherent module-transformation data
statement:
Use the quasicategories, coherent functors, mapping spaces and universes of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], monoidal infinity-categories of [def-coef-monoidal-infinity-category], cartesian fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], the ordered-fibre category $L=N(\mathsf{LM}^{\otimes})$, its pure-algebra part $A$, coherent left tensorings and module sections of [def-coef-left-module-operadic-encoding], and the operation-tree and parameterized transformation data of [lem-coef-colored-operation-section-reconstruction]. Let $\mathcal V$ be monoidal and $\mathcal M$ coherently left-tensored by $q:E^\otimes\to L$. Let $B,C,D$ be associative algebra sections, $h:B\to C$ an algebra transformation, $L_C$ a module section over $C$, and $N$ a module section over $D$. Put $x=L_C(m)$. Suppose $L_h$ is a module section over $B$ reconstructed from the precomposed operation and tree data of [lem-coef-module-scalar-restriction-coherence], and $e_h:L_h\to L_C$ is reconstructed from its transformation data $(h,1_x)$. Write $\Theta$ for restriction of module sections to $A$.

For every algebra map $g:D\to B$, postcomposition by $e_h$ identifies the space of coherent module-transformation data from $N$ to $L_h$ with algebra component $g$ with that from $N$ to $L_C$ with algebra component $hg$. The comparison preserves the underlying map $f:N(m)\to x$ and identifies the operation-naturality data by
$$f\,b^N_r\simeq b^{L_C}_r((hg)^{\otimes r}\otimes f)=b^{L_h}_r(g^{\otimes r}\otimes f).$$
The last equality uses the specified coherent composition of the tensor action. This identification includes all operation-tree comparisons and all chains of contractions, rather than only these displayed equations. It has a coherent inverse, is natural in $N$ and in $g$, and holds over every simplicial family of algebra maps $g$, compatibly with restriction of parameters. Thus it identifies the full spaces of such transformation data over $\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Alg}(\mathcal V)}(D,B)$, not merely their sets of components. The forward comparison reconstructs to postcomposition with $e_h$. The assertion concerns operation data and does not assume that $\Theta$ is a cartesian fibration. No presentability or colimit hypothesis is required.
